title: Upward Technologies B.V. founded in Breda, Netherlands, launching DocSign and Reach
content_html:
Upward Technologies B.V. was founded on 21 September 2026 in Breda and launched with two products for Dutch companies that lose time to manual work.

DocSign is for digital signatures. It lets teams send documents for signature, store every signed version in one place, set up templates, add multiple signers, verify email addresses, send reminders and set expiry dates. Every signature creates an audit trail. When signing is complete, the system issues a completion certificate. DocSign also includes data rooms with watermarking and two-factor login for sensitive files.

Reach is for business outreach. It finds prospects, helps write personal messages to approach them, builds lead lists, warms up email addresses and checks deliverability. It includes a sales pipeline to track conversations, a unified inbox so no message gets missed, and handles opt-outs under the GDPR (the EU privacy law). Upward Technologies discusses what unsolicited message rules allow before a customer starts.

Upward Technologies builds software and then runs it. All staff work inside the European Economic Area (EEA). Both products are offered as SaaS (Upward hosts and updates the software, and the customer's data stays theirs and can be exported) or adapted to fit a customer's process and connected to their systems.
